name: Chamomile
shortDescription: Small white flowers with sunny yellow centres.
description: Chamomile is a delicate flowering herb with daisy-like blooms and a gentle apple-like scent.
use: A calming herbal tea made from dried flowers.
growingTips: Grow in a sunny place with well-drained soil. Pick fully open flowers on a dry day.
alt: White chamomile flowers with yellow centres
